description_en: Invokes the DescribeCustomRoutingEndpointGroup operation to query the configuration of a specified endpoint group that is associated with a custom routing listener
description_zh: 调用DescribeCustomRoutingEndpointGroup接口查询自定义路由类型监听关联的指定终端节点组配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun ga describe-custom-routing-endpoint-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --endpoint-group-id epg-bp1dmlohjjz4kqaua0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCustomRoutingEndpointGroup

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the endpoint group to query
parameters.name: endpoint_group_id

AcceleratorId.description_en: The instance ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance

AccessLogSwitch.description_en:
The binding status of the access log. Valid values:
on: The access log is bound.
off: The access log is not bound.
binding: The access log is being bound.
unbinding: The access log is being unbound
AccessLogSwitch.description_zh:
日志绑定状态。
on：已绑定。
off：未绑定。
binding：绑定中。
unbinding：解绑中

Description.description_en: The description of the endpoint group
Description.description_zh: 终端节点组的描述信息

EnableAccessLog.description_en:
Indicates whether the access log feature is enabled.

true: The access log feature is enabled.

false: The access log feature is disabled
EnableAccessLog.description_zh:
是否开启了访问日志。

true：已开启访问日志。

false：未开启访问日志

EndpointGroupId.description_en: The ID of the endpoint group

EndpointGroupIpList.description_en: The list of public IP addresses of the endpoint group
EndpointGroupIpList.description_zh: 终端节点组出公网IP列表

items.description_en: The list of public IP addresses of the endpoint group
items.description_zh: 终端节点组出公网IP列表

EndpointGroupRegion.description_en: The region ID of the endpoint group
EndpointGroupRegion.description_zh: 终端节点组所属的地域ID

EndpointGroupUnconfirmedIpList.description_en: The list of unconfirmed public IP addresses of the endpoint group that are added after the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance is upgraded
EndpointGroupUnconfirmedIpList.description_zh: 全球加速实例升级后新增待确认的终端节点组出公网IP列表

items.description_en: The list of unconfirmed IP addresses of the endpoint group that are added after the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance is upgraded
items.description_zh: 全球加速实例升级后新增待确认的终端节点组IP列表

ListenerId.description_en: The ID of the custom routing listener

Name.description_en: The name of the endpoint group

ServiceId.description_en:
The ID of the service that manages the managed instance.
This parameter is valid only when ServiceManaged is set to True
ServiceId.description_zh:
托管实例所属的服务方ID。
仅在ServiceManaged参数为True时有效

ServiceManaged.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance is managed. Valid values:

true: The instance is managed.

false: The instance is not managed
ServiceManaged.description_zh:
是否为托管实例。取值：

true：是托管实例。

false：不是托管实例

ServiceManagedInfos.description_en:
The list of action policies that the user can execute on the managed instance.

This parameter is valid only when ServiceManaged is set to True.
When the instance is in the managed state, operations that the user can perform on the instance are restricted, and certain operations are prohibited
ServiceManagedInfos.description_zh:
用户在此托管实例下可执行的动作策略列表。

仅在ServiceManaged参数为True时有效。
当实例处于托管状态时，用户对实例的操作会受到限制，某些操作行为会被禁止

items.description_en: The list of action policies that the user can execute on the managed instance
items.description_zh: 用户可在该托管实例执行的动作策略列表

Action.description_en:
The name of the managed policy action. Valid values:
Create: Create an instance.
Update: Update the current instance.
Delete: Delete the current instance.
Associate: Reference or be referenced by the current instance.
UserUnmanaged: Unmanage the instance.
CreateChild: Create a child resource under the current instance
Action.description_zh:
托管策略动作名称，取值：
Create：创建实例。
Update：更新当前实例。
Delete：删除当前实例。
Associate：引用/被引用当前实例。
UserUnmanaged：用户解托管实例。
CreateChild：在当前实例下创建子资源

ChildType.description_en:
The type of the child resource. Valid values:
Listener: listener resource.
IpSet: acceleration region resource.
EndpointGroup: endpoint group resource.
ForwardingRule: forwarding rule resource.
Endpoint: endpoint resource.
EndpointGroupDestination: protocol mapping resource of the endpoint group under the custom routing listener.
EndpointPolicy: access policy resource of the endpoint under the custom routing listener.
This parameter is valid only when Action is set to CreateChild
ChildType.description_zh:
子资源类型，取值：
Listener：监听资源。
IpSet：加速地域资源。
EndpointGroup：终端节点组资源。
ForwardingRule：转发策略资源。
Endpoint：终端节点资源。
EndpointGroupDestination：自定义路由监听下的终端节点组协议映射资源。
EndpointPolicy：自定义路由监听下的终端节点通行策略资源。
仅在Action参数为CreateChild时有效

IsManaged.description_en:
Indicates whether the managed policy action is managed. Valid values:
true: The managed policy action is managed. The user cannot perform the action specified by Action on the managed instance.
false: The managed policy action is not managed. The user can perform the action specified by Action on the managed instance
IsManaged.description_zh:
托管策略动作是否被托管，取值：
true：托管策略动作被托管，用户无权在托管实例下执行Action指定的操作。
false：托管策略动作未被托管，用户可在托管实例下执行Action指定的操作

SlsLogStoreName.description_en: The name of the Simple Log Service Logstore

SlsProjectName.description_en: The name of the Simple Log Service project

SlsRegion.description_en: The region of the logs that are created in Simple Log Service
SlsRegion.description_zh: 在日志服务中创建的日志信息所属地域

State.description_en:
The status of the endpoint group. Valid values:
init: The endpoint group is being initialized.
active: The endpoint group is running as expected.
updating: The endpoint group is being updated.
deleting: The endpoint group is being deleted
State.description_zh:
终端节点组的状态。
init：初始化。
active：正常。
updating：更新中。
deleting：删除中
